Iris Kirby: Hi everyone! I'm Iris — starting today as a SWE on infra. Remote from NYC (EST) for the first week. Pronouns she/her. Obsessed with mechanical keyboards, microgreens, and sunrise runs. Coffee habit: oat cappuccino or black. Will probably spam one or two corgi pics later :dog: :wave:

OnboardBot: Welcome Iris Kirby! Glad to have you. Please review the #new-hires checklist and say hi in #random when you can: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/checklist

Sam Rhee: Welcome Iris!! :tada: Pixel pics are required for team morale. What keyboard layout are you into — 60% or full-size? :keyboard:

Ben O'Connor: Yay welcome! If you're into keyboards there's a small hardware club that meets Fridays in the office. Also, rooftop hang next Thu 6pm if you're around. :sun_with_face:

June Park: Hey Iris — belated welcome from SF. Office coffee uses oat by default, so you're set. Also love microgreens, we have a tiny shelf garden in the breakroom. :herb: :coffee:

Alex (People Ops): Welcome aboard! I'll DM you about badge pickup and swag (there's usually at least one keyboard keycap in the new-hire box :smile:). We also run a monthly show-and-tell — keyboards and corgis welcome.

Iris Kirby: Thanks everyone — remote this week but aiming to visit the office next Friday. Would love recs for nearby lunch spots by the office (something quick and tasty). Pixel photo incoming when I figure out how to stop her from stealing socks :joy:

Sam Rhee: Tacos two blocks west = instant win. Also small salad place on the corner if you want lighter.

Ben O'Connor: Bagels in the morning on 3rd street are the move. Also we sometimes order group lunches via the #lunch channel — ping me if you want to join next week.

June Park: If you swing by SF office another time, there's a rooftop herb garden you can biopsy for microgreens (jk, ask first). :seedling:

Sam Rhee: Also tagging @eng so folks know a new infra SWE joined. Welcome again Iris! :partyparrot:
